summary: Judged thesis intact throughout: price moved favorably from entry almost immediately, peaked near +56pts around t=8-12m, and despite several sharp pullbacks (giveback spikes to 65-160% of recent leg amplitude, e.g. the t=17m dip to +15.75pts and the against-fires from HA/PROPP/KMDR), it never approached breakeven or went negative -- every dip was followed by a bounce back into the +20-45pt favorable zone, so I never saw evidence of a wrong-direction, non-recovering move and held to the end of the window. What I'd watch next time: the against-direction fire clusters (HA/PROPP/KMDR all firing against within 1-3min of each other) preceded the sharpest pullbacks, so stacking 2+ against-fires plus a giveback ratio >100% could be an earlier warning even in a trade that's still net favorable, worth testing as a partial-de-risk trigger rather than a full bail signal.
